title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Billing Error Decision Table: Related Other Charge on a Duplicate Foreign Posting
content:
**Rule.** For a notice that a purchase processed in a foreign currency or outside the United States posted twice to a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the related other charge is the fee the posting in error caused: when a returned payment fee was assessed after the latest statement date for a payment of at least the latest statement balance, and the posting in error posted on or before the latest statement date (the returned payment carried the posting in error), it is that returned payment fee; when no such returned payment fee was assessed but a late fee was assessed for the billing period in which the posting in error posted, it is that late fee; otherwise it is zero.

The records read are the account's returned payment fees (their dates and the payments they point to, with those payments' amounts), the latest statement's date and balance, the late fees by the billing period they belong to, and the posting in error's posting date and billing period.

## Decision table

| Returned payment fee after the latest statement date, on a payment of at least the latest statement balance, posting in error on or before that date | Late fee for the posting in error's billing period | Related other charge |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | that returned payment fee |
| no | yes | that late fee |
| no | no | zero |

## Cases (hypothetical; latest statement dated 30 June with a balance of USD 1800.00; posting in error posted 18 June)

| Event | Related other charge |
|---|---|
| a USD 2000.00 payment returned unpaid, USD 29.00 returned payment fee assessed 8 July | USD 29.00 |
| a USD 500.00 payment returned unpaid, fee assessed 8 July; a USD 32.00 late fee for the June period | USD 32.00 |
| no returned payment fee; no late fee for the June period | zero |
